query: The RoleTailored Client says 'The server is not responding' for all users since this morning.
expected_behavior: Maps the symptom to the Service Tier and routes to nav2009-service-tier-admin for inventory/status
Checks the obvious chain first: NST service state, port reachability, database availability
Does not start performance tuning or code review for an availability symptom

query: Posting a purchase order fails with a deadlock error in NAV.
expected_behavior: Classifies it as a locking symptom and routes to nav2009-sql-performance (deadlocks/blocking sections)
Mentions the C/AL side (lock ordering, transaction length) via nav2009-development for the fix
Asks whether it is reproducible/concurrent-load-dependent before proposing changes

query: After importing objects last night, users get compile errors opening the item card.
expected_behavior: Maps the symptom to a deployment issue and routes to nav2009-object-management (compile with sync)
Suggests compiling the affected objects and checking naverrorlog output
Considers schema synchronization as the likely cause after table changes
